deleteUser(String) - Method in class com.hkust.marketplace.repositories.UserRepository
Permanently deletes a buyer/seller account in one transaction: locks/validates the account first, so retrying a deletion is idempotent (a missing account aborts before any counter is touched); marks the seller's listings REMOVED and deletes the user's notifications; increments the participant-deletion counter (deleted, capped at 2) on every deal and chat thread they participate in, cancelling still-open deals when one participant remains; deletes the user row; the deals/chat/listing FKs use ON DELETE SET NULL, so the preserved records keep the remaining participant. Admin accounts cannot be removed here.
